Testing helps slow and stop the spread of #Omicron.

Check out @SNHDinfo for more information and get tested if you may have been exposed or are experiencing symptoms.

Congratulations Jolie Li of Clark High School on winning NV03's Congressional App Competition for her app, Smile. 

Smile is a wonderful example of how we can use technology to support mental wellness for young people, and your success is an inspiration to girls across Nevada! https://t.co/HjTe82rZs3

This week marks 100 years since the first treatment of diabetes with insulin. It was revolutionary and its discovery continues to save lives every day.

But it's 100 years old. Insulin shouldn't break the bank.

This weekend marks the 49th anniversary of Roe. v Wade. 

At a time when extremist politicians are seeking to exercise control over our healthcare decisions, we must stand up for Roe. I voted to pass #WHPA to codify Roe. Now the Senate must step up and join us.

On this National Black HIV/AIDS Awareness Day, we call out the inequities in our health care system and recommit ourselves to stand up for better access to testing, prevention, and treatment. Let's end the stigma and #StopHIVTogether.

1 in 10 Americans has diabetes. Insulin has been used in treatment for 100 years, and drug companies can make it for about $10 a vial.

So why are they charging Americans 30x that?

It's time to #LowerDrugPrices.

Kicked off this week with a special (& sweaty) edition of Susie Shops Small at the woman-owned 103 Hot Pilates and Yoga. Thank you for a great workout and for helping to build such a strong community of local health & fitness small businesses in the Valley! https://t.co/VmLK8N3Vgc

Great day to be in Boulder City with city officials and Mayor Kiernan McManus!

I'm proud to have secured $1 million to upgrade outdated systems at the Boulder City Wastewater Treatment Plant to ensure that Boulder City residents have access to safe, clean water. https://t.co/5fcGOS9UKi

Proud to have fought to secure these funds for safe & clean drinking water in Boulder City.

https://t.co/2ZDTk0mjMs

Passed The House ☑

My bipartisan Virtual Peer Support Act just passed the House as part of the #RestoringHope for Mental Health & Well-Being Act.

This package includes 30+ programs to support mental health care and substance use disorder prevention, care, & treatment services. https://t.co/kiuP2gFFNm

Across this country, from #SCOTUS to Fremont St., we are seeing Americans exercise democracy.

I see you. I hear you. I stand with you.

To the women who are sharing your stories, thank you. I will fight tirelessly for Washington to match your bravery & commitment to this fight. https://t.co/FE6tDXjaDJ

I'm absolutely sickened to hear this news. My heart goes out to the loved ones of the victims and I am praying for those who are in treatment right now. Thank you to the members of the @LVMPD for their quick action on the scene.

Our vets deserve the best care possible. That’s why I’m proud to have voted for the #PACTAct, so all of our veterans can get the lifesaving treatment they need for exposure to burn pits.

For help with screenings & benefits, contact my office or visit: https://t.co/gZ9pDFEQcM

Scientific breakthroughs have led to huge advancements in the prevention and treatment of HIV.

On #HIVTestingDay, make a plan to get tested and figure out next steps so you can stay healthy no matter your results. https://t.co/lsR1CAdwNd

Cardiovascular Disease is the #1 killer for women over 25, which means we need better awareness, screening, & treatment to save lives.

Proud to lead a bipartisan letter with @KatCammack, @RepEmiliaSykes, & @MonicaDeLaCruz urging HHS Sec. Becerra to prioritize women’s health.

Please exercise safety when heading out to Lake Mead this weekend. Conditions can change rapidly & inflatable toys are not life preservers.

With the right amount of caution, care, & responsibility, we can ensure everyone enjoys this precious resource.
https://t.co/zgHYnu78es

When I was an education nonprofit leader, the #1 resource we provided students was food. But extremists in Washington are threatening to gut critical food programs like SNAP & WIC.

Yesterday, I heard from child nutrition experts who emphasized the need to protect these programs. https://t.co/Q9lzNLn2hI

When someone is struggling with substance abuse, early treatment can save lives — especially when it comes to our nation’s youth.

I’m proud to introduce a bill that will reauthorize a critical prevention & recovery program to get kids the support they need. https://t.co/rcc2ZXY8Cg

When students have access to better nutrition, tutoring, after-school programs & mental health resources, they achieve more in school.
 
I’m proud to announce that Nevada families will be benefiting from over $2 million in federal investments to support kids beyond the classroom. https://t.co/rjVAPMp5k7

On this #WorldAIDSDay, I am joining my colleagues in the @EqualityCaucus to encourage testing, promote education, and end stigmas about HIV & AIDS. Let’s #StopHIVTogether by increasing access to preventative medicine, testing, and treatment. https://t.co/jCyDnrojWO

After the fall of #Roe, it wasn’t just a possibility that anti-choice extremists would go after IVF — it was an inevitability.

The truth is that infertility is an illness & IVF is the treatment. I won't stop fighting to protect it for families like mine.https://t.co/vVk5heXm1R

Spanish Hills Wellness Suites is a state-of-the-art, 144-bed, healthcare and rehabilitation center here in #NV03.

It was a pleasure to visit their facilities and meet with so many of the hardworking health care professionals and their residents this weekend. https://t.co/CaSScU1Tmj

It’s always great to host a fellow Nevada elected official here in DC.

Jack was recently elected as Clark County Youth Mayor and is passionate about nutrition in schools, student mental health, and expanding access to STEM education.

Thanks for stopping by, Mayor Leatham! https://t.co/SGbUeBPpXm

Every night, 8,000 southern Nevadans don’t have a roof to sleep under.   It was great to join Dr. Catrina Grigsby-Thedford and leaders at all levels of government this morning for @NHAvoice’s Conference on Addressing Homelessness to discuss how we can make that number zero. https://t.co/C1GgRLjniU

🚨⚠️NEVADA: There is one week until Election Day, meaning only one week left for you to exercise your right to vote.

Nevadans can vote early until November 1, meaning you can vote TODAY.

Learn more about voting in Nevada here: https://t.co/F9JTIEYmxZ
